decisions.reason: As a close-to-core office system with several models, it likely meets aspiration well enough to retain, and the firm's workplace focus supports continued commitment.
The chair family is a core complement to the premium furnishing range, so without clear evidence of results below aspiration it is kept.
The floor cushions are still more peripheral and thus more vulnerable to problemistic search, but their material-led fit and available slack still favor retention.
After several years, the sofa's weaker prominence and less distinctive role make an aspiration shortfall more likely, so resources are better redirected to stronger lines and new development.
The high standing table fits the firm's evolving workplace and conference offering closely, so withdrawal is unlikely unless performance newly falls below aspiration.
